<div class="job-title">Interdisciplinary Biochemist, M.Sc.</div>
<div class="intro-text">
<p>I am Umashankar P., an interdisciplinary biochemist with research experience spanning lipid metabolism, mass spectrometry, molecular biology and genome engineering.</p>
<p>My current research focuses on sunflower lipid metabolism through CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing and metabolic engineering. I am particularly interested in connecting molecular interventions with quantitative metabolic phenotypes using GC-MS/MS and related analytical approaches.</p>
<p>I am interested in PhD opportunities, research collaborations and interdisciplinary projects at the interface of plant molecular biology, lipidomics, metabolic engineering and analytical science.</p>
</div>

(() => {
  const topics = {
    plant:["Plant molecular biology","Sunflower transformation, tissue culture, regeneration, genotyping and expression analysis."],
    lipid:["Lipid metabolism","TAG biosynthesis, DGAT2, fatty-acid composition, FAD genes and omega-3 enrichment."],
    crispr:["CRISPR/Cas9 genome engineering","gRNA strategy, cloning, genome-editing vectors and molecular characterisation."],

  };
  const title=document.getElementById("explorer-title"), text=document.getElementById("explorer-text");
  document.querySelectorAll(".explorer-btn").forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".explorer-btn").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("is-active"));

    const d=topics[btn.dataset.topic];
    title.textContent=d[0]; text.textContent=d[1];
  }));
})();
</script>
